settings.block_description: Set the Tone for Your Retreat
settings.modal_content:
What's Your Color of Calm?

Your FireLight® Sauna is more than a retreat—it’s a reflection of your rhythm, your rituals, your inner state. The color you choose sets the tone for how the space holds you. It’s not just aesthetic—it’s atmospheric. Energetic. Deeply personal.


Each shade in the FireLight® palette offers a different kind of calm. Natural is completely unbleached and undyed, with delicate flecks that speak to its raw, elemental purity. It’s perfect for sensitive systems, minimalist spaces, and those who crave quiet honesty in every detail.


Stone offers a similar lightness, but with a clean, even tone achieved through gentle, low-impact dyeing. It’s soft and serene, like a quiet breath—elegant without drawing attention to itself.


For those drawn to depth, Indigo and Dark Chocolate create a cocooning, grounding effect, anchoring the space with richness and shadow. Along with Stone, both are crafted using GOTS-certified, low-impact dyes, balancing beauty, environmental integrity, and lasting vibrance. Each fabric holds the light differently. Each palette creates its own kind of sanctuary.


Hand-Dyed Turmeric brings a deeper warmth, both visually and energetically. It’s created using ayurvastra, an ancient Ayurvedic dyeing tradition that infuses the fabric with plant medicine. In this case, organic turmeric: a revered botanical known for its anti-inflammatory and restorative properties. The result is more than color; it subtly imbues the space with the restorative properties of the plant itself.

settings.modal_button_title: Need help choosing your intensity level?
settings.modal_content:
Go SuperSauna for Maximum Impact

The Classic FireLight® Sauna is a beautiful beginning—but for those ready to experience the most powerful sessions possible, SuperSauna is the next step. With seven bulbs instead of four, it nearly doubles your light and heat coverage, delivering deeper penetration and faster core heating.


The result? You can cut your session time in half while achieving the same—if not greater—therapeutic benefits. SuperSauna is ideal for experienced users, intensive detox protocols, and high-performance routines. It’s trusted by wellness professionals, longtime FireLight users, and serious biohackers alike.


Not sure you’re ready? You can always start simple and upgrade later—no pressure, just possibilities.

Shield Your Sauna with SilverLining™

Woven with 35% silver thread and organic cotton, SilverLining™ blocks up to 99.99% of external EMF frequencies, ranging from 40kHz to 40GHz. Every element of the FireLight® Sauna is designed to emit virtually no EMFs—but SilverLining™ adds a critical layer of protection from the ambient radiation already present in most modern environments, including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, smart meters, and cellular signals.


That shielding makes a difference. Even low-level environmental EMFs can activate your nervous system, pulling you out of the parasympathetic state your body needs for deep healing and detox. By reducing this background interference, SilverLining™ helps optimize the conditions for restoration—clearing the way for your body to heal more deeply, more fully, and with less resistance.


Third-party tested and proven, it’s the ultimate upgrade for those seeking a cleaner signal, deeper calm, and the most restorative session possible.

Where do you live?

All our products are plug-and-play with a standard outlet anywhere in the world. Our FireLight® Bulbs are available in 120V and 240V versions, depending on where in the world you wish to use your sauna.


120V Countries

USA Plug is for the USA, Canada, Japan, Central America, some of South America and any countries with 120V electrical supply. Your Hearth(s) ship(s) with 120V FireLight® Bulbs, and shielded power cord with Plug Type B. Both Classic and SuperSauna models work on common standard 120V 15A or 120V 20A circuit.


220-240V Countries

Europe, Asia, Australia, New Zealand, Africa, the Middle East and all countries with 220-240V electrical supply. Like the USA, most countries with 220-240V has both ungrounded and grounded plug types. To benefit from our unique EMF-shielding and grounding technology you must use the recommended grounded plug type that is supplied with your product. Your Hearth(s) ship(s) with a grounded plug adapter and 240V FireLight® Bulbs. Both Classic and SuperSauna models work on a standard 220-240V 8A or 220-240V 10A circuit with the supplied power cord and the included plug adapter.


Choose the correct Plug for your country and it will include the correct grounded plug adapter for you:


AU/NZ: Grounded Type I plug adapter for Australia and New Zealand


BRAZIL: Grounded Type N plug adapter for Brazil areas that use 220V. If you live in an area of Brazil that uses 120V, contact us to customize your order, because you will instead need the 120V FireLight® bulbs along with your Type N plug adapter.


EURO: Grounded Type F plug adapter, which is now standard in almost all countries in Europe and also in Israel. Do NOT use an ungrounded 2-prong Type C.


INDIA: Grounded Type D plug adapter.


SWISS: Grounded Type J plug adapter. Do NOT use an ungrounded 2-prong Type C.


UK: Grounded and fused Type G. Do NOT use an unfused Type G plug adapter, because the UK has a unique looped current electrical supply that requires all appliances to have a special fused plug.

settings.title: No One Does Infrared Like Us
settings.content: We've spent years crafting the perfect hand-blown sauna bulb. We mimic the best of the sun—with none of the harmful UV—to create full-spectrum infrared therapy that is truly one of a kind.

settings.question: How is the FireLight® Sauna different from far infrared saunas?
settings.answer:
Most saunas heat the air around you. Ours heats you directly.

Far infrared (FIR) saunas use longer wavelengths that warm the skin but don’t support photobiomodulation. The FireLight® Sauna uses incandescent near infrared light (700–1500 nm) that penetrates deeper, raises core temperature faster, and activates true cellular healing.

No LEDs, no flicker, no preheat, just real, radiant heat designed for detox and renewal.

settings.question: Why canvas instead of wood?
settings.answer:
Because it’s lighter, cleaner, and built for modern living.

Our natural canvas enclosure is portable, breathable, and tool-free to assemble, perfect for apartments, studios, or anywhere space is sacred. Unlike bulky wooden saunas, it won’t off-gas toxins, trap moisture, or grow mold over time. It’s washable, air-permeable, and naturally resistant to buildup.

But don’t mistake soft for weak. The double-layered canvas insulates like a pro, holding heat beautifully while staying gentle on your senses. With the SilverLining™ upgrade, it becomes a grounded Faraday space, fully shielded from EMFs and static.

It’s a return to simplicity: honest materials, intentional design, and a nervous-system-safe sanctuary that fits wherever you are.

settings.question: Will I sweat and how hot does it get?
settings.answer:
Yes, and not just a surface sweat, but a full-body, cellular-level release that feels like the sun wrapping you in its arms.

Unlike traditional or far-infrared saunas that heat the air around you, the FireLight® Sauna uses radiant near infrared light (980–1500 nm) to heat your body directly. This thermal near infrared penetrates deep into tissues, raising your core temperature from the inside out, fast. No preheating required. Just step in, switch on, and the transformation begins.

Most people begin sweating within 5 minutes. In the Classic Sauna (4 bulbs), a full session is around 20–30 minutes. In the SuperSauna (7 bulbs), it’s even faster, closer to 15–20 minutes.

It doesn’t feel like steam or stifling air. It feels clean. Grounded. Regenerative. The kind of sweat your body remembers. The kind that heals.

settings.question: What are the power requirements?
settings.answer:
No electrician required.

Choose 120 V for North America or 240 V for international use. Both Classic and SuperSauna models plug into standard outlets with the correct adapter.

Need more country-specific info? Read our full plug and voltage explanation.

settings.question: Why can’t I lie down in this sauna?
settings.answer:
Because upright posture activates more than just your sweat.

The FireLight® Sauna is designed to engage your whole system. Sitting tall allows for better circulation, deeper light absorption, and more effective detoxification. It opens your breath, aligns your spine, and supports full-body exposure as you gently rotate.

Lying down may feel restful, but it reduces lymphatic flow, collapses posture, and limits the therapeutic reach of the light. Upright, you’re not just receiving warmth, you’re participating in the healing.

It’s not about being rigid, it’s about being awake. Present. Fully lit.

settings.question: Do I need a special stool or chair?
settings.answer:
Yes, and it’s included.

The Basswood Sauna Stool supports proper alignment and is handcrafted for comfort, breathability, and rotation. Once you use it, you’ll never go back.

settings.question: Do I rotate during my session?
settings.answer:
Yes, and it’s a core part of how FireLight® works.

Our saunas are designed for full-body exposure. As you gently rotate every few minutes, each side of your body receives direct, radiant near infrared light, no need for extra bulbs or longer sessions. Some people turn in quarters, others sway side to side. Let your body set the rhythm.

Rotation also creates natural thermal contrast: while one side warms, the other cools slightly. This activates circulation, enhances lymphatic flow, and drives the heat deeper into your tissues.

In the SuperSauna® (7 bulbs), most people reach a 3°F core temperature rise and release about a pound of water in just 15 minutes. The Classic (4 bulbs) takes closer to 20–30. No preheat, no steam, just real, radiant heat that moves with you.

settings.question: How much does it cost to run?
settings.answer:
Surprisingly little, for something that makes you feel so good.

The Classic Sauna uses 1000W, costing around 16¢ per hour.

The SuperSauna runs at 1750W, about 29¢ per hour based on average U.S. energy rates.

That’s less than a cup of tea, and far more rejuvenating.

settings.question: Is it easy to set up alone?
settings.answer:
Very.

Tool-free assembly takes 20–40 minutes. No drilling, contractors, or special skills required.

Watch the Classic Sauna setup video, and also the SuperSauna setup video.

settings.question: What if I live in a small space?
settings.answer:
You don’t need a spa wing.

The FireLight® Sauna was designed to fit beautifully into real homes, with a compact trapezoid footprint: 52” wide at the front, narrowing to 24” at the back. Whether you tuck it into a bedroom, guest room, office, or studio corner, it’s self-contained and easy to integrate.

Clean, low-profile, and plug-and-play, healing at home has never been this effortless.

settings.question: What does it feel like inside?
settings.answer:
Quiet. Warm. Grounding.

Natural materials, soft light, and a radiant glow that melts stress away. It’s like stepping into a sunlit cocoon.

settings.question: Is it noisy or electronic?
settings.answer:
Not at all.

No fans, buzz, or beeps, just silent, flicker-free incandescent light. Perfect for meditating or listening to music.

settings.question: Do I need to wait for it to heat up?
settings.answer:
Nope.

Flip the switch and step in. The bulbs deliver instant heat and light, zero preheat required.

settings.question: Can I leave it set up all the time?
settings.answer: Yes. Its aesthetic and footprint work well in any room, and it’s easy to disassemble if needed.

settings.question: Is it safe if I have heat or EMF sensitivity?
settings.answer:
Yes, and even recommended.

The FireLight® Sauna heats you directly without stifling air. Add SilverLining™ for full EMF shielding and Faraday protection, ideal for those with EHS and for nervous system healing.

settings.question: Can I use it while detoxing or fasting?
settings.answer:
Absolutely.

FireLight® supports detox pathways, mitochondrial energy, and lymph flow. Just hydrate, support electrolytes, and ease in gently.

settings.question: What should I wear inside?
settings.answer:
Less is more.

Nude or light cotton is best. No synthetics, they block light and can off-gas.

settings.question: When will I feel results?
settings.answer:
Some feel better after one session.

Others notice deeper benefits over time: better sleep, fewer aches, improved mood. This is a practice. It builds.

settings.question: How long do the FireLight® Bulbs last, and how do I replace them?
settings.answer:
The FireLight® Bulb is rated for 5,000 hours and typically lasts 5 to 10 years, depending on use. When it eventually burns out, replacing it is simple. It screws in just like a standard bulb, no tools needed.

If it burns out within five years, we’ll replace it for free under our warranty. After that, you’ll still get a special replacement price of $95.

Long-lasting, easy to replace, and always backed by us.

settings.title: The FireLight® Sauna FAQ
settings.content: Got questions about the FireLight® Sauna? You’re not alone. From first-time users to seasoned sauna lovers, many are curious about what makes this full-spectrum infrared system so different. Below, we answer the most common questions about setup, sweating, safety, and why radiant near infrared light delivers a sauna experience unlike anything else. Whether you’re upgrading your detox routine or creating a healing space at home, you’ll find everything you need to get started, beautifully.

settings.title: How does the FireLight® Sauna compare to a far-infrared (FIR) sauna?
settings.content:
All saunas aim to raise your core body temperature—but how they do it makes all the difference.

Far-infrared (FIR) saunas use longer wavelengths (typically 3000+ nm) that are absorbed mostly by water, which means they primarily heat the surface of your skin. This can make sessions slower and less efficient, often requiring long preheat times—sometimes 40 minutes or more. FIR light also doesn’t activate photobiomodulation, because our bodies don’t have light-sensitive receptors (chromophores) for those wavelengths.

To compensate, some FIR saunas add red or near-infrared LED panels. But LEDs are flickery, narrow-spectrum, and lack the therapeutic heat and broad-spectrum harmony of incandescent light.

Our FireLight® Sauna uses primarily near infrared (NIR) incandescent light (700–1500 nm), which penetrates deeper into tissue, raises your core temperature faster, and delivers full-spectrum radiant heat—just like sunlight, but without the UV. This supports real photobiomodulation, full-body detox, and deep cellular rejuvenation.

In short:

  • FIR: Slower, surface-level heating. No photobiomodulation.
  • FireLight®: Deep heat, fast sessions, real light therapy.

Built to mimic nature. Backed by biology. Designed to transform.

settings.title: Why does the FireLight® Sauna have a canvas enclosure instead of wood?
settings.content:
Because it’s smarter, safer, and more beautiful in every way.

Our natural canvas enclosure makes the FireLight® Sauna portable, breathable, and tool-free to set up—ideal for apartments, guest rooms, or anywhere life flows. Unlike heavy wooden boxes, it’s easy to move, won’t off-gas toxins, and won’t trap moisture over time. In fact, most wooden saunas are prone to mold. Ours isn’t. The fabric is washable, air-permeable, and naturally resistant to buildup.

But don’t mistake lightness for fragility. The canvas is double-layered, tightly woven, and incredibly durable—providing excellent insulation that rivals traditional wood saunas. It holds heat beautifully while staying gentle on the senses.

Aesthetically, it’s a return to something ancient and essential: simple materials, honest construction, and a sanctuary that honors your nervous system. Add the SilverLining™ upgrade, and you’ve got a Faraday-shielded space free from EMFs, static, and interference.

Minimal footprint. Maximum healing. This is the future of sauna design—rooted in tradition, refined for modern life.

settings.title: Will the FireLight® Sauna make me sweat? How hot does it get?
settings.content:
Yes—intensely and efficiently. You’ll start sweating within just a few minutes, and you’ll keep sweating for the duration of your session.

The FireLight® Sauna uses radiant near infrared heat (thermal near infrared 980 - 1500 nm) that penetrates deep into your tissues, raising your core body temperature from the inside out. Unlike traditional or far-infrared saunas, which heat the air around you, FireLight® heats you directly—so you’re not sitting in a box of stifling air, gasping for breath. It feels more like basking in the sun than sitting in a steam room.

In the Classic Sauna (4 bulbs), most people complete a full session in about 20–30 minutes. In the SuperSauna (7 bulbs), it’s closer to 15–20. No preheating needed. Just step in, switch on, and your body gets to work.

The result? A steady, sustained sweat that feels clean, grounded, and deeply invigorating—without the lung-scorching heat.

settings.title: What are the FireLight® Sauna's electrical requirements?
settings.content:
All FireLight® Saunas are plug-and-play—no electrician needed. We offer 120 V and 240 V versions, depending on where in the world you’ll be using your sauna.

For 120 V Countries (e.g. USA, Canada):
Choose the USA Plug. Your Hearth ships with 120 V FireLight® Bulbs and a standard plug adapter. Both the Classic and SuperSauna models work with a standard wall outlet, using a standard 15 A, 120 V circuit.

For 220–240 V Countries (Europe, Asia, Australia, New Zealand, Africa, the Middle East, Brazil, India, and others):
Choose the plug option that matches your country: EURO, UK, SWISS, AU/NZ, BRAZIL, or INDIA. Your Hearth will ship with 240 V FireLight® Bulbs and the correct plug adapter. Both the Classic and SuperSauna models work on a standard 8 A or 10 A, 220-240 V circuit—no rewiring required.

Still not sure? Just check the voltage printed on your wall outlet or reach out to our team. We’ll make sure you get exactly what you need.

settings.title: Why can’t I lie down in the FireLight® Sauna?
settings.content:
Because lying down makes it passive. Sitting upright makes it powerful.

The FireLight® Sauna is designed to engage your whole system—not just warm you up. When you sit upright with good posture and rotate slowly, you get full-body exposure, enhanced lymphatic flow, and deeper light absorption. Your breath opens, your spine aligns, and your detox pathways work more effectively.

Lying down reduces circulation, collapses your posture, and limits your body’s ability to sweat and release. It may feel relaxing, but it misses the point. This is active healing, not nap time.

Think of it less like lounging—and more like aligning. Upright. Present. Fully lit.

settings.title: Do I need a special stool or chair in the sauna?
settings.content:
Yes—and we’ve designed one that’s pretty much perfect.

The FireLight® Sauna comes with our signature Basswood Sauna Stool, crafted specifically to support your posture and optimize your session. It’s the right height, the right shape, and made from the right material: lightweight, non-toxic, and naturally grounding.

Sitting upright on the stool keeps your spine aligned and your heart open—allowing for better breath, deeper parasympathetic activation, and full-body light exposure as you rotate. The seat is gently curved for comfort and stability, and it stores flat when not in use.

It may seem like a small detail, but once you try it, you'll understand: this stool changes everything.

settings.title: Do I rotate my body during my sauna session?
settings.content:
Yes—and it’s a key part of how SaunaSpace works.

Our saunas are designed for dynamic, full-body exposure. As you gently rotate throughout your session, each side of your body receives direct, radiant light—no need for extra bulbs or longer sessions.

There’s no strict rule. Most people rotate every 3 to 5 minutes, or simply whenever it feels right. Some turn in quarters, others do a slow side-to-side flow. Let your body guide the rhythm.

Beyond even exposure, rotation creates thermal contrast—while one side heats, the other cools slightly. This activates circulation and drives heat deeper into your tissues, amplifying the internal healing response.

In the SuperSauna® (7 bulbs), most people reach a 3°F core temperature increase (plus about a pound of water loss) in just 15 minutes. In the Classic Sauna (4 bulbs), it takes about 20–30 minutes. No preheat, no steam, no gasping—just real, radiant heat that moves with you.

settings.title: How much does it cost to operate the FireLight® Sauna?
settings.content:
Not much—especially for something that supports your detox, boosts your circulation, calms your nervous system, and leaves you glowing.

The Classic Sauna (4 bulbs, powered by a Hearth™ Quartet) uses 1000W, which comes out to about 16¢ per hour based on average U.S. energy rates.

The SuperSauna (7 bulbs, powered by a Hearth™ Quartet and a Hearth™ Trio) uses 1750W, costing around 29¢ per hour.

That’s less than a load of laundry—and infinitely more restorative.

settings.title: Can I set up the sauna by myself? How hard is it, really?
settings.content:
You can absolutely do it yourself—and most people do.

Every FireLight® Sauna is designed for easy, tool-free assembly. Just unbox, unzip, and follow the simple steps. Setup takes about 20-40 minutes, quicker if you’ve done it before.

No contractors, no confusing instructions, and no need to drill holes in your walls. It’s designed to go up and down as needed, whether you’re moving houses or just rearranging a room. And when not in use, it packs flat for low-profile storage.

settings.title: What if I don’t have much space?
settings.content:
You don’t need a spa wing in your home.

The FireLight® Sauna was designed to fit beautifully into real homes. Both the Classic and SuperSauna share the same compact, trapezoidal footprint—52" x 52" at the front, narrowing to 24" at the back. It tucks easily into bedrooms, home offices, guest rooms, or a quiet corner of your studio.

There’s no plumbing, ventilation, or special wiring required—and no lingering steam or humidity. When you’re done, just unzip the door and let the warmth fade. Many people leave the lights on for a few extra minutes to gently dry the stool and mat covers. That’s all it takes.

Clean. Self-contained. Elegantly efficient.

settings.title: What does it feel like to sit inside?
settings.content:
Peaceful. Warm. Surprisingly profound.

The inside of the FireLight® Sauna is a soft cocoon of natural materials: organic canvas, raw basswood, and radiant light. No harsh lights, no beeping electronics, no glass screens or buzzing panels.

It feels like sunlight on your skin—but deeper. The warmth penetrates your muscles and bones without overwhelming your lungs. Most people describe it as grounding, comforting, and a little bit addictive.

settings.title: Is the sauna loud? Does anything buzz or beep?
settings.content:
Nope. It’s completely silent.

There are no fans, no electronics, and no motors—just pure incandescent light, gently heating your body. If you want to listen to music or meditate while inside, you’ll have a perfectly quiet space to do so.

settings.title: How long does it take to heat up?
settings.content:
Zero minutes.

The moment you turn it on, the FireLight® Bulbs begin emitting both heat and light. You can step in immediately—no waiting, no warm-up cycle. Most people start sweating within 5 minutes.

settings.title: Can I leave it set up all the time?
settings.content:
Yes—and many people do.

The sauna is designed to be a permanent part of your space, even if it’s not in a spa room. Its minimalist footprint and organic aesthetic make it easy to integrate into a bedroom or studio.

But if you do need to take it down, it’s easy to disassemble and store flat.

settings.title: Is it safe for people who are sensitive to heat or EMFs?
settings.content:
That’s exactly who we designed it for.

Because the FireLight® Sauna heats you directly—not the air—you’re less likely to feel lightheaded or overwhelmed, even if you’re heat-sensitive. And with the SilverLining™ upgrade, you get full EMF shielding, turning your sauna into a grounded Faraday space that’s ideal for people with EHS, mold illness, or nervous system dysregulation.

settings.title: Can I use it while fasting, detoxing, or on a protocol?
settings.content:
Yes—and it can actually enhance your results.

Near infrared light supports mitochondrial energy, lymphatic flow, and detoxification pathways, making it an ideal companion to structured wellness protocols. Just make sure to hydrate well, support your electrolytes, and ease into it if your system is already under stress.

settings.title: What should I wear inside?
settings.content:
As little as possible.

The more skin exposed, the more light and heat your body receives. Most people go nude or wear a light cotton towel. No synthetic fabrics (they can block light or off-gas). Just keep it simple, breathable, and comfortable.

settings.title: How long before I feel results?
settings.content:
Many people notice the difference after a single session—especially with sleep, mood, or muscle tension.

Others feel the deeper benefits over time: fewer headaches, more stable energy, better recovery, improved resilience. Like anything worth doing, it builds. Light works with your body, not against it.

settings.title: How long do the FireLight® Bulbs last, and how do I replace them?
settings.content:
The FireLight® Bulb is rated for 5,000 hours and typically lasts 5 to 10 years, depending on use. When it eventually burns out, replacing it is simple—it screws in just like a standard bulb, no tools needed.

If it burns out within five years, we’ll replace it for free under our warranty. After that, you’ll still get a special replacement price of $95.

Long-lasting, easy to replace, and always backed by us.
